description: This file contains a base class implementation for unit testing the MediaPipeline IPC component, including setup, teardown, and mock expectations for IPC session creation, event subscription, and cleanup.

classes.name: MediaPipelineIpcTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing setup, teardown, and mock expectation methods for testing MediaPipeline IPC interactions.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up mock objects after tests.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineIpc
methods.description: Creates and initializes the MediaPipeline IPC object with mock expectations.

methods.name: expectSubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for subscribing to various IPC events.

methods.name: expectUnsubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for unsubscribing from IPC events.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipelineIpc
methods.description: Destroys the MediaPipeline IPC object and cleans up expectations.

methods.name: setCreateSessionResponse
methods.description: Mocks the response for creating a session, setting the session ID.
